ownership_ack.bounded_pilot_proposal: accepted as proposed by bill (replicate 0, two wirings, label-blind sampling 256/64, 2026 fold, 7 fits, 8 label-blind queries, CPU 1 / 300 s / 2 GiB / 256 MiB, stop-and-report failure rule)

generated_manifest.per_path_npz_hashes: verified against the manifest before any read
generated_manifest.hidden_use: regime values at the preselected rows only, read by the state-target builder; never by the sampler, encoder, forward-risk or retrieval code

flybrake_reference.reused: wiring semantics (row-normalised PN->KC; rewiring preserves each KC input degree and weight multiset, not PN out-degree totals) and sparse top-k code semantics; nothing else

time_model_R6.model_time: the experiment runs in session-index model time: every record carries the session index D and the session label from the file; no real-date finality is claimed for any session
time_model_R6.row_trimming: rows after the earliest source_received_at (adj 11:54:53) completion rule are trimmed: last retained session index = index of 2026-11-05 (the 2026-11-06 row is dropped); both source timestamps are retained in the results; the maximum receipt (raw 12:02:16) is recorded as input receipt, the minimum as the trimming cutoff
time_model_R6.modeled_clocks_for_ordering_only: decision_at(D) = model confirmation of session D = close(D) + 60 s; label availability(E_close20 at D) = close(D+20) + 60 s; these clocks order availability only and are labelled retrospective_latest_vintage; ordinary-session assumption; special sessions are not modeled

frozen_cutoffs.schedule: identical to the frozen B folds (timing_lgbm_v1 spec b0c7e7b4)
frozen_cutoffs.interpretation: a label at D is admissible for a fit at cutoff c iff D + 20 <= c (its availability clock close(D+20)+60 s <= decision_at(c) = close(c)+60 s)

time_model_R6.evaluation_cutoff: data end = index of 2026-11-05; an outcome at D is scorable iff D + 20 <= data end; predictions for later D are written as unscored with counts (R2); the same rule applies to F2 query outcomes

eligibility_and_masks_R5.feature_eligible: council_io.features status ok (>= 200 closes, finite, sd20 > 0)
eligibility_and_masks_R5.encoder_abstain: a row abstains for an encoder when its pre-top-k activation has no positive entry (zero code)
eligibility_and_masks_R5.paired_comparison_mask: rows that are feature-eligible AND target-scorable (maturity rule) AND non-abstaining under BOTH the connectome and the rewired encoder; every compared method (Fly-connectome, Fly-rewired, native logistic, LightGBM, prior constants) is fitted and scored on this same mask
eligibility_and_masks_R5.reported_counts: feature-eligible rows, abstentions per encoder, intersection (mask) size, coverage per split/fold
eligibility_and_masks_R5.native_full_coverage: a native-method result on all feature-eligible rows may be reported as a separately labelled diagnostic, never as the comparison
eligibility_and_masks_R5.label_blind_sampling: state rows are chosen by fixed stride over each path's feature-eligible indices before any hidden label is read: m = 256 per train path, 64 per check/test path; if the paired mask later removes rows they are dropped, not resampled (counts reported); maximum 15,360 train and 2,560 evaluation rows

encoder_R4.scaler: per-feature mean and population std on feature-eligible real sessions with D <= 3031 (2014-12-30); float64 arrays stored; abort if any std == 0
encoder_R4.projection_P: shape 344 x 10, entries N(0, 1/10) (sd = 1/sqrt(10)), from numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([20261107, 80, 0])), float64 stored, float32 used in products

wirings.connectome: W = row-normalised PN->KC weights from mb_right.npz (flybrake.wiring semantics re-implemented; rows with zero input stay zero)
wirings.rewired: per-row degree- and weight-multiset-matched rewiring with default_rng(SeedSequence([20261107, 87, 0])), then the same row normalisation; shares P, scaler, data order and readout initialisation with the connectome variant

encoder_R4.activation: x_scaled = (V_D - mean) / std; pn = relu(x_scaled @ P.T); a = pn @ W.T (theta = 0); top-k with k = 129 chosen by stable descending sort on a with lower KC index first on ties; keep only positive entries among the k (fewer if some are <= 0); z = kept / (||kept||2 + 1e-12); if no positive entry -> abstain
encoder_R4.dtypes_and_storage: codes stored sparse: int16 KC indices and float32 values per row (<= 129 each); dense activations exist only per batch of <= 1,024 rows; caches work/council_phase1_pilot_v1/codes/{version_id}/{real|path_id}.npz written once (xb)
encoder_R4.identity: encoder_version_id = sha256 over (encoder code version string, feature order list, scaler mean and std bytes, P bytes, W bytes, theta bytes, k, epsilon, connectome file sha256); recorded with every cache and result; two versions in the pilot; one variant is processed at a time

readout_solver_R4.model: offline logistic readout on a fixed sparse Fly code (not the original online avoid/homeostasis model): multinomial for the state head (3 classes), binary for the forward head
readout_solver_R4.objective: L(W, b) = (1/n) x sum over rows of cross-entropy(softmax or sigmoid(z_i W + b), y_i) + (lambda / 2) x ||W||_F^2 with lambda = 1.0; the intercept b is not penalised; no class weights; n = rows in the paired mask of the fit
readout_solver_R4.optimiser: full-batch gradient descent, learning rate 0.5 on the mean-loss gradient, exactly 200 iterations (the iteration cap is the stopping rule; no tolerance-based early stop), zero initialisation of W and b, float64 accumulators; identical for Fly and native heads
readout_solver_R4.reporting: final loss, final gradient norm, whether the loss decreased monotonically, iteration count; non-decrease or non-finite loss is reported as non-convergence and the run stops (no retry, no parameter change)
readout_solver_R4.probabilities_R7: outputs are recorded as uncalibrated probability vectors with explicit class order: state [down, up, neutral], forward [no_event, event]; clipping to [1e-6, 1 - 1e-6] for log-loss only
readout_solver_R4.baselines_R7: train-only class-prior constant (fitted by counting on the fit rows; no optimiser) and a zero-logit frozen head (uniform probabilities; its argmax is deterministic and is reported as a mechanical artefact, not as chance accuracy); no theoretical chance-accuracy claim

F1_state_pilot.target: S_generated_state_at_D with the declared mapping down={descent,crash}, up={ascent,rebound}, neutral={sideways,highvol}; labels read only at the preselected rows
fits: native multinomial logistic on the 10 scaled features (computed once; shared by all replicates in any later study, R8)
F1_state_pilot.evaluation: confusion matrices, per-class precision/recall, macro-F1, Brier and log-loss (uncalibrated) on check and on test rows of the paired mask, separately; per combination id breakdown; no threshold choice

F1_forward_pilot.target: E_close20 via council_io.label_e_close20 and gated_label under the model clocks
F1_forward_pilot.fold: 2026 only (engineering pilot, chosen now, no sweep): fit rows = paired-mask real sessions with D + 20 <= 5731; scored rows = paired-mask sessions with D > 5731 and D + 20 <= data end; unscored predictions = eligible sessions with D + 20 > data end (counted)
fits: native binary logistic on the 10 scaled features

T_forward LightGBM on the 10 features: objective binary, num_leaves 7, max_depth 3, learning_rate .05, min_data_in_leaf 200, lambda_l2 1, 200 rounds, seed 0, num_threads 1, deterministic, force_col_wise; output recorded as an uncalibrated probability
F1_forward_pilot.operating_point_R1: p >= 0.5 only; no quantile rule in the pilot
F1_forward_pilot.metrics: on scored rows: positives, negatives, confusion matrix, precision, recall, false-alarm rate, warning rate at 0.5; Brier and log-loss (uncalibrated); detection delay and persistence deferred until an episode definition is frozen (R7)

F2_retrieval_pilot.queries: 8 label-blind queries: equally spaced indices over the scored window [first feature-eligible D > 3031, data end - 20], positions round(first + j x (last - first) / 7) for j = 0..7
F2_retrieval_pilot.candidates: real sessions s < D with E_close20 availability clock <= decision_at(D) (s + 20 <= D under the model clocks), same encoder version, non-zero code, outcome {event, ret20, max_dd} from council_io labels; council_io.retrieve with k = 10, min_separation = 21, target E_close20
F2_retrieval_pilot.query_outcome: reported only if D + 20 <= data end; otherwise marked unscored
F2_retrieval_pilot.outputs: per query: cases (similarity, label_end_index, outcome, max_drawdown_in_window), similarity_spread, eligible/returned counts, measured retrieval time; descriptive comparison of retrieved event share vs realised event where scorable

budget_and_caps_R3.measurement: wall time, peak RSS and output bytes are measured in the pilot and reported; no runtime claim is made for the later study from row counts

failure_rule: stop and report on timeout, memory, disk, hash mismatch, label-availability violation, hidden-file access outside the state-target builder, or non-convergence; preserve partial outputs and a failure record; no automatic budget expansion, repeated fits, hyperparameter changes or sample changes

outputs.results: council_phase1_pilot_results.json written once (xb): all hashes, encoder version ids, row selections, mask counts, solver reports, metrics, F2 records, measurements, limitations
outputs.runlog: work/council_phase1_pilot_runlog_<UTC>.json outside the output directory (thread env, UTC start/end, exit, stdout/stderr, before/after hashes of code, inputs, connectome, peak RSS, output bytes)

selftests_before_approval: toy connectome (6 PN, 20 KC) and toy paths <= 64 rows, toy real series <= 400 rows; no real data beyond hashes and calendar
encoder determinism; version id changes when any component (scaler, P, W, theta, k, epsilon, feature order, connectome sha) changes
rewiring preserves each KC row's input degree and weight multiset
scaler computed from the prefix only (changing later rows leaves it unchanged)
label-blind stride sampling reproducible and independent of hidden labels
fit admissibility by availability clock at the cutoff; scored/unscored split at data end; unscored rows never counted as negatives
paired mask: abstaining rows removed from every method alike; counts reported
solver on a separable toy decreases the loss monotonically and reports the final gradient norm; non-finite loss stops
probability vectors sum to 1, class order recorded; prior-constant baseline equals training frequencies
retrieval candidate clocks under model time; 8 equally spaced queries reproducible
RAM and output caps enforced with tiny caps on the toy run
later_study_not_in_this_document: replicates 0..4, all 12 forward folds, full state rows: 11 state fits (5 x 2 Fly + 1 native) + 144 forward fits (5 x 2 x 12 Fly + 12 native + 12 LightGBM) = 155 fits; sparse caches and one variant at a time; its own budget after pilot measurements
limitations_stated_in_results: no real current-trend ground truth: state heads are scored only on generated regimes under a declared mapping
forward results are one retrospective year on latest-vintage data with overlapping labels; one replicate; no significance or robustness claim
model time only; no real-date finality
F2 similarity is resemblance, not prediction
